name: std::uniform_random_bit_generator
intro: The concept uniform_random_bit_generator<G> specifies that G is the type of a uniform random bit generator, that is, objects of type G is a function object returning unsigned integer values such that each value in the range of possible results has (ideally) equal probability of being returned.

sections.title: Semantic requirements
sections.text:
uniform_random_bit_generator<G> is modeled only if, given any object g of type G:

g() is in the range [G::min(), G::max()],
 g() has amortized constant complexity.

sections.title: Notes
sections.text: In order to satisfy the requirement std::bool_constant<(G::min() < G::max())>::value, both G::min() and G::max() must be constant expressions, and the result of the comparison must be true.
